rules.statement: An action to have a gift revoked on the ground of subsequent birth of a child is not subject to Section 6 of the Prescription Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "It seems to me that an action to have a gift revoked on the ground of the subsequent birth of a child is based on a cause of action 'not expressly provided for' in the Ordinance, and therefore becomes prescribed within 3 years from the time when the cause of action has accrued (Section 10)."
